title: Edge-Gradient Augmentation under Reinforcement Learning for Temporal Graph
abstract: arXiv:2611.16678v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Temporal link prediction is critical for understand- ing dynamic interactions in evolving networks, informing appli- cations ranging from social network analysis to recommendation systems. Existing methods typically rely on raw temporal graph data, often neglecting explicit edge-change information that can significantly improve predictive performance. To address this gap, we propose edge-gradient reinforced learning (EG-RL), a framework that explicitly encodes edge-gradient events (edge births and deaths) through dedicated node and link encoding modules. EG-RL uses a policy-driven reinforcement-learning mechanism to dynamically select and augment the most infor- mative edge snapshots, guided by critic-based feedback to opti- mize prediction accuracy. The model comprises distinct modules for node encoding, link encoding, token mixing, and channel mixing, integrated through global pooling and followed by a two-layer multilayer perceptron

translated_title: 基于强化学习的时序图边梯度增强
translated_abstract: 时序链路预测对于理解演化网络中的动态交互至关重要，为从社交网络分析到推荐系统等诸多应用提供支持。现有方法通常依赖于原始时序图数据，往往忽略了能够显著提升预测性能的显式边变化信息。为弥补这一不足，我们提出边梯度强化学习框架（EG-RL），该框架通过专门的节点编码和链路编码模块，显式地编码边梯度事件（即边的出现与消失）。EG-RL采用策略驱动的强化学习机制，在基于评论家反馈的引导下，动态选择并增强信息量最大的边快照，以优化预测精度。该模型由节点编码、链路编码、令牌混合和通道混合等独立模块组成，通过全局池化进行整合，其后接一个两层多层感知机。
tldr: 本文提出EG-RL框架，利用强化学习机制动态选择并增强时序图中信息量最大的边梯度事件（边的出现与消失），从而显著提升时序链路预测的准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EG-RL, a reinforcement learning framework that dynamically selects and augments the most informative edge-gradient events (edge births and deaths) in temporal graphs to significantly improve temporal link prediction accuracy.
